connects_to.relationship: air-cooled Blackwell GPU systems supplied under the Dell Purchase Agreement

contracts.signal: On May 19, 2026, IREN subsidiary IE US Hardware 4 and Dell entered into the Dell Purchase Agreement, under which Dell will supply GPUs and ancillary products and services (air-cooled Blackwell systems, inclusive of GPUs, servers, storage, networking, ancillary equipment, integration services and warranties) for approximately $1.6 billion, payable in installments within 30 days of each tranche shipping. The systems will be deployed across existing data centers at IREN's Childress, Texas campus to service IREN's previously announced five-year, $3.4bn managed services AI cloud contract, with commissioning targeted for early 2027.

players.product: AI GPU cloud (liquid + air-cooled data centers; 5 GW secured power, target 150k GPUs)

quarterly_data.signal: IREN says that upon commissioning of the Dell-supplied Blackwell systems, its five-year $3.4bn AI cloud contract is expected to increase annualized run-rate revenue (ARR) from $3.7bn to $4.4bn. Per the release, the $4.4bn represents expected $1.9bn average annual revenue under the Microsoft contract, expected $0.7bn average annual revenue under the $3.4bn AI cloud contract and an estimated $1.8bn ARR from planned GPU deployments at British Columbia and Childress; it is not fully contracted.
quarterly_data.figure: ARR $3.7bn to $4.4bn (Microsoft contract $1.9bn; $3.4bn AI cloud contract $0.7bn; planned British Columbia and Childress deployments $1.8bn)
